habits.boundary_condition: Treat walking-distance beach access as a preference rather than a universal hard requirement when the trip is not beach-oriented
habits.condition: When choosing lodging for a coastal or beach-oriented trip
habits.default_action: Prioritize properties on the beach or close enough to walk to it
habits.exception_condition: Allow other location needs, such as proximity to an event venue, to constrain the choice
habits.name: prefer_beach_proximity_for_coastal_hotels
habits.preference_value: A hotel on or near the beach, preferably within walking distance
habits.rationale: Three independent hotel searches consistently request beach or ocean proximity, with two explicitly asking for walkable access.

source_evidence.contribution: Supports prioritizing beachfront or very close beach access, preferably within a short walk.
source_evidence.exact_user_quote: I would like to stay in Naples, Florida at the beachfront, very close to the beach. Less than 5-minute walk is preferable.

source_evidence.contribution: Independently supports on-beach or walkable beach proximity alongside other selection criteria.
source_evidence.exact_user_quote: And we want to be on the beach or close to, within walking distance. I want it to be $300 or less per night. 4 stars on Google.

source_evidence.contribution: Independently supports coastal proximity as a hotel-location preference.
source_evidence.exact_user_quote: I need something that's near an ocean.
